def build_octopus():
    col = "Octopus"
    parent = "OctopusChef"

    # Mantle
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_uvsphere(bm, u_segments=48, v_segments=32, radius=1.0)
    for vert in bm.verts:
        p = shape_unit(vert.co)
        vert.co = Vector((p.x * SX, p.y * SY, p.z * SZ)) + HEAD
    finish("Mantle", bm, M("skin"), col, parent, True)

    # Paler underside
    belly_at = mantle_point((0.0, -0.55, -0.72), lift=0.01)
    uv_sphere(
        "Belly",
        0.20,
        belly_at,
        M("belly"),
        col,
        parent,
        scale=(1.15, 0.72, 0.85),
        u=28,
        v=16,
    )

    # Spots
    spot_dirs = [
        (0.7, -0.6, 0.45),
        (-0.85, -0.45, 0.35),
        (0.35, -0.9, 0.05),
        (-0.25, -0.4, 0.85),
        (0.9, -0.2, -0.05),
        (-0.7, -0.7, -0.15),
    ]
    for i, d in enumerate(spot_dirs):
        pos = mantle_point(d, lift=0.012)
        scl = 0.045 + (i % 3) * 0.012
        uv_sphere(
            f"Spot_{i}",
            scl,
            pos,
            M("spot"),
            col,
            parent,
            scale=(1.0, 0.55, 0.85),
            u=12,
            v=8,
        )

    # Eyes — sit on the front of the mantle, glancing down at the bowl
    eye_dirs = [Vector((0.40, -1.0, 0.18)), Vector((-0.40, -1.0, 0.18))]
    for i, d in enumerate(eye_dirs):
        side = "L" if d.x > 0 else "R"
        base = mantle_point(d, lift=0.0)
        outward = Vector(d).normalized()
        # sink slightly so the sphere beds into the head
        center = base + outward * 0.012
        uv_sphere(f"EyeWhite_{side}", 0.105, center, M("eye_white"), col, parent, u=28, v=16)
        iris_c = center + outward * 0.055
        uv_sphere(f"Iris_{side}", 0.064, iris_c, M("iris"), col, parent, u=20, v=12)
        # pupils biased toward the bowl and a little downward
        bowl_bias = (BOWL_C + Vector((0, 0, 0.12)) - center).normalized()
        pupil_c = center + outward * 0.072 + bowl_bias * 0.022
        uv_sphere(f"Pupil_{side}", 0.038, pupil_c, M("pupil"), col, parent, u=16, v=10)
        # catchlight toward the key light (upper left of frame, -X +Z -Y)
        catch = center + outward * 0.088 + Vector((-0.034, -0.02, 0.038))
        uv_sphere(f"Catch_{side}", 0.020, catch, M("highlight"), col, parent, u=10, v=8)
        # soft upper lid — skin-colored arc
        lid_center = center + Vector((0.0, 0.0, 0.02))
        arc_tube(
            f"Lid_{side}",
            lid_center,
            outward,
            Vector((1.0, 0.0, 0.15)).cross(outward),
            0.092,
            0.022,
            math.radians(30),
            math.radians(150),
            M("skin"),
            col,
            parent,
            n=8,
        )
        # blush
        blush_at = mantle_point((d.x * 1.35, -0.85, -0.18), lift=0.015)
        uv_sphere(
            f"Blush_{side}",
            0.055,
            blush_at,
            M("blush"),
            col,
            parent,
            scale=(1.2, 0.45, 0.7),
            u=14,
            v=8,
        )

    # Smile and a small open mouth
    mouth_c = mantle_point((0.0, -1.0, -0.38), lift=0.02)
    arc_tube(
        "Smile",
        mouth_c + Vector((0.0, -0.01, -0.005)),
        Vector((0.0, -1.0, 0.0)),
        Vector((1.0, 0.0, 0.0)),
        0.09,
        0.016,
        math.radians(200),
        math.radians(340),
        M("mouth"),
        col,
        parent,
        n=12,
    )
    uv_sphere(
        "MouthInner",
        0.045,
        mouth_c + Vector((0.0, 0.01, -0.01)),
        M("mouth_in"),
        col,
        parent,
        scale=(1.15, 0.55, 0.7),
        u=16,
        v=10,
    )

    # Hat — toque planted on the crown, tipped forward and a little to the side
    crown = mantle_point((0.0, -0.08, 1.0), lift=0.0)
    hat_pivot = crown + Vector((0.0, 0.0, -0.02))
    tilt = Euler((math.radians(11), math.radians(-13), math.radians(5)), "XYZ").to_matrix().to_4x4()
    hat_xf = Matrix.Translation(hat_pivot) @ tilt @ Matrix.Translation(-hat_pivot)

    def hat_part(name, bm_builder_mesh_fn):
        return None

    # brim
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=32, radius1=0.34, radius2=0.34, depth=0.045
    )
    transform_bm(bm, Matrix.Translation(hat_pivot + Vector((0, 0, 0.02))))
    transform_bm(bm, hat_xf)
    finish("HatBrim", bm, M("hat"), col, parent, True)

    # pleated crown
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=40, radius1=0.25, radius2=0.27, depth=0.40
    )
    for vert in bm.verts:
        ang = math.atan2(vert.co.y, vert.co.x)
        rad = math.hypot(vert.co.x, vert.co.y)
        if rad > 1e-4:
            # stronger pleats toward the top
            height_t = (vert.co.z + 0.2) / 0.4
            amp = 0.012 + 0.012 * max(0.0, height_t)
            nr = rad + amp * math.cos(ang * 10.0)
            vert.co.x = math.cos(ang) * nr
            vert.co.y = math.sin(ang) * nr
    transform_bm(bm, Matrix.Translation(hat_pivot + Vector((0, 0, 0.24))))
    transform_bm(bm, hat_xf)
    finish("HatCrown", bm, M("hat"), col, parent, True)

    # soft top
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_uvsphere(bm, u_segments=32, v_segments=16, radius=0.27)
    for vert in bm.verts:
        vert.co.z *= 0.55
    transform_bm(bm, Matrix.Translation(hat_pivot + Vector((0, 0, 0.44))))
    transform_bm(bm, hat_xf)
    finish("HatTop", bm, M("hat"), col, parent, True)

    # red band at the brim
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=28, radius1=0.345, radius2=0.345, depth=0.028
    )
    transform_bm(bm, Matrix.Translation(hat_pivot + Vector((0, 0, 0.055))))
    transform_bm(bm, hat_xf)
    finish("HatRibbon", bm, M("scarf"), col, parent, True)

    # Neckerchief
    scarf_z = HEAD.z - 0.16
    torus(
        "Scarf",
        0.30,
        0.032,
        (HEAD.x, HEAD.y + 0.02, scarf_z),
        M("scarf"),
        col,
        parent,
        rot=Euler((math.radians(78), 0.0, 0.0), "XYZ"),
        major_seg=28,
        minor_seg=8,
    )
    knot = mantle_point((0.0, -1.0, -0.55), lift=0.03)
    uv_sphere("ScarfKnot", 0.045, knot, M("scarf"), col, parent, scale=(0.8, 0.7, 0.8), u=14, v=10)
    for sx, nm in ((-0.03, "A"), (0.035, "B")):
        box(
            f"ScarfTail_{nm}",
            (knot.x + sx, knot.y - 0.01, knot.z - 0.07),
            (0.04, 0.012, 0.11),
            M("scarf"),
            col,
            parent,
            rot=Euler((math.radians(18), math.radians(8 if sx > 0 else -8), 0), "XYZ"),
        )

    # Apron bib
    bib_c = mantle_point((0.0, -1.0, -0.72), lift=0.035)
    box(
        "Apron",
        (bib_c.x, bib_c.y, bib_c.z - 0.02),
        (0.34, 0.02, 0.30),
        M("apron"),
        col,
        parent,
        rot=Euler((math.radians(8), 0, 0), "XYZ"),
    )
    box(
        "ApronPocket",
        (bib_c.x, bib_c.y - 0.012, bib_c.z - 0.08),
        (0.14, 0.018, 0.09),
        M("apron"),
        col,
        parent,
    )
    # little red bowl mark on the pocket
    uv_sphere(
        "ApronMark",
        0.028,
        (bib_c.x, bib_c.y - 0.02, bib_c.z - 0.08),
        M("apron_trim"),
        col,
        parent,
        scale=(1.0, 0.35, 1.0),
        u=12,
        v=8,
    )
    # neck strap
    torus(
        "ApronStrap",
        0.20,
        0.012,
        (HEAD.x, HEAD.y - 0.02, scarf_z + 0.06),
        M("apron"),
        col,
        parent,
        rot=Euler((math.radians(80), 0, 0), "XYZ"),
        major_seg=24,
        minor_seg=6,
    )

    build_tentacles()

def build_booth():
    col = "Booth"
    parent = "RamenBooth"

    # Floor — interior planks plus a stone apron in front
    bm = bmesh.new()

    def append_box(bm, loc, size, mat_index):
        tmp = bmesh.new()
        bmesh.ops.create_cube(tmp, size=1.0)
        for vert in tmp.verts:
            vert.co.x = vert.co.x * size[0] + loc[0]
            vert.co.y = vert.co.y * size[1] + loc[1]
            vert.co.z = vert.co.z * size[2] + loc[2]
        tmp.verts.ensure_lookup_table()
        tmp.faces.ensure_lookup_table()
        mapping = [bm.verts.new(v.co) for v in tmp.verts]
        index = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(tmp.verts)}
        for face in tmp.faces:
            nf = bm.faces.new([mapping[index[v]] for v in face.verts])
            nf.material_index = mat_index
        tmp.free()

    # wooden deck
    x = -1.28
    i = 0
    while x < 1.28:
        w = 0.18
        append_box(bm, (x + w / 2, 0.35, 0.04), (w - 0.008, 2.15, 0.08), i % 2)
        x += w
        i += 1
    floor = finish("FloorPlanks", bm, (M("plank_a"), M("plank_b")), col, parent, False)

    # stone threshold toward the customer
    box("Threshold", (0.0, -0.85, 0.025), (2.7, 0.55, 0.05), M("stone"), col, parent)

    # Counter carcass
    box("CounterBody", (0.0, 0.55, 0.50), (2.05, 0.78, 0.78), M("wood_dark"), col, parent)
    box("CounterTop", (0.0, 0.50, COUNTER_Z - 0.025), (2.22, 0.96, 0.06), M("wood"), col, parent)
    # front lip highlight
    box("CounterLip", (0.0, 0.035, COUNTER_Z - 0.01), (2.22, 0.03, 0.09), M("wood_lite"), col, parent)
    # inset front panel
    box("CounterPanel", (0.0, 0.175, 0.48), (1.7, 0.02, 0.52), M("wood"), col, parent)
    # toe kick
    box("ToeKick", (0.0, 0.22, 0.06), (1.9, 0.70, 0.08), M("trim"), col, parent)

    # Posts
    for sx in (-1.12, 1.12):
        for sy, tag in ((-0.02, "F"), (1.22, "B")):
            cylinder(
                f"Post_{tag}_{'L' if sx < 0 else 'R'}",
                (sx, sy, 0.0),
                (sx, sy, 2.18),
                0.045,
                M("wood_dark"),
                col,
                parent,
                segs=12,

GLYPHS = {
    "A": [" ### ", "#   #", "#   #", "#####", "#   #", "#   #", "#   #"],
    "E": ["#####", "#    ", "#    ", "#### ", "#    ", "#    ", "#####"],
    "H": ["#   #", "#   #", "#   #", "#####", "#   #", "#   #", "#   #"],
    "I": ["#####", "  #  ", "  #  ", "  #  ", "  #  ", "  #  ", "#####"],
    "M": ["#   #", "## ##", "# # #", "#   #", "#   #", "#   #", "#   #"],
    "N": ["#   #", "##  #", "# # #", "#  ##", "#   #", "#   #", "#   #"],
    "O": [" ### ", "#   #", "#   #", "#   #", "#   #", "#   #", " ### "],
    "R": ["#### ", "#   #", "#   #", "#### ", "# #  ", "#  # ", "#   #"],
    "S": [" ####", "#    ", "#    ", " ### ", "    #", "    #", "#### "],
    "U": ["#   #", "#   #", "#   #", "#   #", "#   #", "#   #", " ### "],
    "Y": ["#   #", "#   #", " # # ", "  #  ", "  #  ", "  #  ", "  #  "],
    " ": ["     ", "     ", "     ", "     ", "     ", "     ", "     "],
}


def build_block_text(text, origin, cell, depth, mat, col, parent, name):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    cursor_x = 0.0
    rows = 7
    for ch in text:
        glyph = GLYPHS.get(ch, GLYPHS[" "])
        cols = len(glyph[0])
        for r, row in enumerate(glyph):
            for c, bit in enumerate(row):
                if bit != "#":
                    continue
                # glyph row 0 is the top
                x = origin.x + cursor_x + (c + 0.5) * cell
                z = origin.z + (rows - 1 - r + 0.5) * cell
                y = origin.y
                tmp = bmesh.new()
                bmesh.ops.create_cube(tmp, size=1.0)
                for vert in tmp.verts:
                    vert.co.x = vert.co.x * cell * 0.88 + x
                    vert.co.y = vert.co.y * depth + y
                    vert.co.z = vert.co.z * cell * 0.88 + z
                tmp.verts.ensure_lookup_table()
                tmp.faces.ensure_lookup_table()
                mapping = [bm.verts.new(v.co) for v in tmp.verts]
                index = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(tmp.verts)}
                for face in tmp.faces:
                    bm.faces.new([mapping[index[v]] for v in face.verts])
                tmp.free()
        cursor_x += (cols + 1) * cell
    if not len(bm.verts):
        bm.free()
        return None
    return finish(name, bm, mat, col, parent, False)

def build_ramen():
    col = "Ramen"
    parent = "RamenSet"
    loc = BOWL_C

    lathe(

        bowl_profile(1.0),
        M("ceramic"),

        scale=BOWL_SCALE,
    )
    # cobalt band
    torus(
        "BowlBand",
        0.168 * BOWL_SCALE,
        0.012 * BOWL_SCALE,
        loc + Vector((0, 0, 0.10 * BOWL_SCALE)),
        M("cobalt"),
        col,
        parent,
        major_seg=28,
        minor_seg=8,
    )
    torus(
        "BowlBand2",
        0.150 * BOWL_SCALE,
        0.006 * BOWL_SCALE,
        loc + Vector((0, 0, 0.078 * BOWL_SCALE)),
        M("cobalt"),
        col,
        parent,
        major_seg=24,
        minor_seg=6,
    )

    broth_z = loc.z + 0.118 * BOWL_SCALE
    cylinder(
        "Broth",
        (loc.x, loc.y, broth_z - 0.008),
        (loc.x, loc.y, broth_z + 0.004),
        0.150 * BOWL_SCALE,
        M("broth"),
        col,
        parent,
        segs=28,
    )
    # oil eyes
    for i in range(6):
        ang = i / 6.0 * math.tau + 0.3
        rad = 0.04 + (i % 3) * 0.03
        ox = loc.x + math.cos(ang) * rad
        oy = loc.y + math.sin(ang) * rad * 0.85
        cylinder(
            f"Oil_{i}",
            (ox, oy, broth_z + 0.004),
            (ox, oy, broth_z + 0.010),
            0.012 + (i % 2) * 0.006,
            M("oil"),
            col,
            parent,
            segs=10,
        )

    # noodle nest
    for s in range(4):
        pts = []
        turns = 2.1 + s * 0.25
        phase = s * 1.7
        for i in range(30):
            t = i / 29.0
            ang = phase + t * turns * math.tau
            rad = (0.035 + 0.07 * math.sin(t * math.pi)) * (0.85 + 0.1 * s)
            rad *= BOWL_SCALE
            z = broth_z - 0.01 + 0.045 * t + 0.008 * math.sin(ang * 2.0 + s)
            x = loc.x + math.cos(ang) * rad
            y = loc.y + math.sin(ang) * rad * 0.82
            pts.append((x, y, z))
        tube(
            f"Noodle_{s}",
            catmull(pts, 3),
            0.010,
            0.008,
            M("noodle"),
            col,
            parent,
            sides=7,
        )

    # chopsticks gripped near the end of that tentacle, dipping into the bowl
    grip = Vector((-0.12, 0.30, 1.24))
    into = Vector((-0.02, 0.34, broth_z + 0.01))
    direction = (into - grip).normalized()
    back = grip - direction * 0.05
    for i, offset in enumerate((-0.008, 0.008)):

def steam_column(name, origin, height, col, parent, n=4, scale=0.04):
    origin = Vector(origin)
    for i in range(n):
        t = (i + 1) / (n + 0.4)
        z = origin.z + height * t
        wobble = Vector((math.sin(t * 7.0 + origin.x) * 0.025, math.cos(t * 5.0) * 0.02, 0.0))
        r = scale * (1.2 - t)
        uv_sphere(
            f"{name}_{i}",
            r,
            origin + wobble + Vector((0, 0, height * t)) - Vector((0, 0, origin.z)) * 0 + Vector((0, 0, 0)),
            M("steam"),
            col,
            parent,
            scale=(1.0, 0.85, 0.7),
            u=10,
            v=8,
        )
        # fix: the expression above is messy but the z is `origin.z` ignored.
        # Reposition properly — sphere was placed with a confused z. Override by
        # rebuilding location: we already passed a location. Let's just set it cleanly
        # by not doing the mess. (Handled below if needed.)


# The steam helper above has a muddled location expression. Replace objects' mesh
# is harder after the fact, so build steam directly here and ignore that function
# body by redefining it before use. Python uses the function as it exists at call
# time, and build_ramen() is called after this redefinition if we redefine now.

def steam_column(name, origin, height, col, parent, n=4, scale=0.04):
    origin = Vector(origin)
    for i in range(n):
        t = (i + 1) / (n + 0.5)
        wobble = Vector(
            (
                math.sin(t * 6.5 + origin.x * 3.0) * 0.03,
                math.cos(t * 5.0 + i) * 0.02,
                0.0,
            )
        )
        center = Vector((origin.x, origin.y, origin.z)) + wobble
        center.z = origin.z + height * t
        r = scale * (1.25 - 0.85 * t)
        uv_sphere(
            f"{name}_{i}",
            max(0.012, r),
            center,
            M("steam"),
            col,
            parent,
            scale=(1.0, 0.8, 0.65),
            u=10,
            v=8,
        )

def bounds():
    mins = Vector((1e9, 1e9, 1e9))
    maxs = Vector((-1e9, -1e9, -1e9))
    faces = 0
    meshes = 0
    for obj in bpy.data.objects:
        if obj.type != "MESH":
            continue
        meshes += 1
        faces += len(obj.data.polygons)
        for corner in obj.bound_box:
            world = obj.matrix_world @ Vector(corner)
            mins.x = min(mins.x, world.x)
            mins.y = min(mins.y, world.y)
            mins.z = min(mins.z, world.z)
            maxs.x = max(maxs.x, world.x)
            maxs.y = max(maxs.y, world.y)
            maxs.z = max(maxs.z, world.z)
    return {

def torus(name, major, minor, loc, mat, col, parent, rot=None, major_seg=28, minor_seg=10):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    rings = []
    for i in range(major_seg):
        ang = 2.0 * math.pi * i / major_seg
        ca, sa = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)
        ring = []
        for j in range(minor_seg):
            bang = 2.0 * math.pi * j / minor_seg
            rad = major + minor * math.cos(bang)
            z = minor * math.sin(bang)
            ring.append(bm.verts.new((rad * ca, rad * sa, z)))
        rings.append(ring)
    for i in range(major_seg):
        i2 = (i + 1) % major_seg
        for j in range(minor_seg):
            j2 = (j + 1) % minor_seg
            bm.faces.new((rings[i][j], rings[i2][j], rings[i2][j2], rings[i][j2]))
    matrix = Matrix.Translation(Vector(loc))

The pupil radius is 0.032, so it extends from 0.033 to 0.097 from the eye center and should visibly protrude from the sclera surface. Previously the gaze vector was heavily weighted toward -Z and -Y, which pushed the pupil inward into the cheek or head rather than onto the front shell.

The head mesh covers the lower half of the eyes, so only the upper hemisphere is visible. The pupils were placed on that hidden lower half, which is why they disappeared inside the face.

The fix is to un-sink the eyes by increasing the lift to 0.02 and bulging them outward. The pupils should then sit on the front-center, slightly below the eye center.

The pupil will sit at 0.62 times the eye radius from the center, slightly below the visible sphere. The iris sits at 0.45 times the radius, and the catch light at 0.75 times the radius. The original eye construction will be restored. The pupil offset will be 0.072 with a small downward bias, and the catch light at 0.088. The eyes will remain slightly protruding but will not be sunken into the head.
